title: 桟橋用両角係船クリート
description: 浮桟橋や運河の縁に配置する低い両角型係船クリート。先端へ細くなり緩く反り上がる一体の二本角、二つの広がった鋳物風支持部、中央補強部、丸めた厚いベースと四つの実際の貫通取付穴を備えます。道路用ボラードとは異なる低い係船金具の外観で、索や取付ボルトは含みません。係留動作、荷重支持、材料強度、耐食性や安全性は検証していない静的表示用です。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.774 × 0.306 × 0.292 m、4,424三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A low double-horn mooring cleat for dock edges and canal-side scenes. A continuous crown has two gently upswept tapering horns above flared cast-style supports, a central reinforcing seat, rounded substantial base and four genuine through mounting holes. This is low-profile mooring hardware rather than a road bollard. No line or mounting bolts are included. Static appearance only; mooring operation, loading, material strength, corrosion resistance and safety are unvalidated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.774 × 0.306 × 0.292 m; 4,424 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
